title: Incorrect condition
detail: The condition should check for both `link` and `meta` to match the original logic.
note: A copy only needs a link id when there's a link.

title: Incorrect lock check
detail: The code checks if the lock is not locked before acquiring it, which can lead to a race condition if another thread acquires the lock between the check and the acquire call.
note: Twisted runs on one thread, so nothing takes the lock between the check and acquire(); not about the dropped await.
